The swelling is in both legs, and the foot pain was just in one foot, right in front of the big toe. Doctor: Have you experienced any chest pain, palpitations, or fever in the past week? Additionally, could you provide details about your past medical history, including any prior diagnoses of heart failure, arthritis, gout, or kidney disease, as well as any medications, allergies, or family history of relevant conditions? Patient: I don't have chest pain or palpitations, and I haven't had a fever. I have a history of coronary disease, had a heart attack in 2018, and had a stent put in my right coronary artery.
